scripts.build: npm run check && vite build && node scripts/clean-build-secrets.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:run
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/prepare-e2e.ts && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute gcse-revision-db --local --file database/seed/development.sql && wrangler d1 execute gcse-revision-db --local --file database/seed/phase4_planner.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute gcse-revision-db --remote --file database/seed/development.sql && wrangler d1 execute gcse-revision-db --remote --file database/seed/phase4_planner.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c dist/gcse_revision/wrangler.json
